kind: missing explicit consumer/test closure for an existing extraction rule
title: Collected escaped-newline keys can fail ordinary runtime lookup
prerequisites: No plugin override; normal translation and message consumers.
Selected language core/game is well-shaped and contains translation Q only under the key obtained from the supplied extracted entry; no translated entry exists for the runtime backslash+n key.
An eligible item success path reaches the pocket message; item and pocket inputs are valid and any prior inventory write succeeds.
Lookup result observed before window processing; no claim about actual language menu/host execution.

ordinary_control.input: A plain item acquisition message using color controls but no escaped newline, with translation Q stored under its actual normalized runtime key.
ordinary_control.expected: Translation Q is selected before numbered parameter replacement. Ordinary message color codes are handled later; this does not itself prevent hash matching.

minimal_counterexample.abstract_input: Author script string literal represents runtime A + U+005C U+006E + B. Collection scans the literal spelling containing two adjacent backslashes followed by n.
minimal_counterexample.setup: Translation Q only under collected key, valid language layers, no matching runtime key.
minimal_counterexample.expected: Ordinary lookup misses and returns original runtime input, subsequently the message layer turns slash+n into a visible newline; Q is not selected.
minimal_counterexample.actual_snapshot_anchor: SCRIPT_TEXTS:1162; serialized collected key exists and counterpart runtime key is absent from supplied compiled core.
minimal_counterexample.limitation: Static derivation plus primitive byte comparison; not a reference-function or engine execution.

cancellation_exception_partial_commit.author_cancel: Selecting no export/declining overwrite retains WP08 existing no-write boundaries; no new side effect invented.
cancellation_exception_partial_commit.author_failure: Full compile still opens/truncates output before parsing; this proposal does not introduce transactional import.
cancellation_exception_partial_commit.runtime: A missing translation is ordinary hash fallback, not a thrown exception. Item/prize/berry messages occur after item writes on inspected success paths; lookup miss does not undo those prior writes.
cancellation_exception_partial_commit.move_learning_caveat: The third anchor also concatenates a pause control inside the translation input; not used as the minimal proof because it has that extra premise.

negative_search.result: No matching local consumer consequence; WP08 rule wording directly reread. This is an omission proposal, not a claim that the documented lexical decode order is wrong.

minimal_revision: Add one implementation-independent paragraph distinguishing collected source spelling from runtime lookup text for escaped newline inputs, one ordinary control and one nonmatching-key vector. Record the supplied generated-key anchors in audit traceability; do not copy their prose into the formal specification. State compatibility choice separately from current observed static behavior.
preserved_scope: Existing extraction decode order remains correct.
Current-language fallback, empty-string hits and later message control behavior remain unchanged.
No assertion that all escaped literals, all SCRIPT_TEXTS or all gameplay translations fail.
No requirement to reproduce the source language parser or its architecture.
acceptance: Ordinary control selects Q under the matching key.
Escaped-newline collected key versus runtime key are differentiated by explicit U+005C/U+000A versus U+005C/U+006E identities before rendering.
Existing cancel/output-truncation/partial item-write premises remain separate.
No host execution or full corpus semantic closure is claimed.
dependencies: WP08 collection/lookup; WP17 message replacement; item reception success-path state changes.
Remaining text reading debt does not affect the narrow observed byte mismatch, but blocks overall localization task completion.

title: Selected-language messages also select UI images, not only prose

source_locations.units: 48 units listed in localized-image-matrix.json; 46 full image identities plus 2 basenames

source_locations.identity: 48 text/binary equal key/body pairs in localized-image-matrix.json

prerequisites: A relevant screen is reached and graphics mode, where present, is enabled.
A valid current-language message layer maps the original image identity A to nonempty image identity B; no plugin overrides.
A and B both resolve to valid suitable images, and normal host image APIs succeed.
Controls background is an ordinary fixed resource while the seven key diagrams are separately translated; do not generalize to all images.

ordinary_control.input: No language translation for one controls key image identity A; A is available.
ordinary_control.expected: Hash fallback returns A, then the screen requests image A. Labels independently follow text localization.

minimal_counterexample.input: Language layer maps the first controls key image identity A to B, with A and B both available but visually distinct; all label translations unchanged.
minimal_counterexample.expected: The screen requests B through the image-adding consumer. A clean-room implementation that localizes labels only will keep A and miss this capability.
minimal_counterexample.observation_boundary: Image identity passed to creation/loading, not actual pixel validation.
minimal_counterexample.scope: One key diagram is sufficient; other literal image identities and minigame basename cases have their own inspected consumers.

cancellation_exception_partial_commit.cancel: No extra language-choice prompt or save write introduced by image lookup; existing startup/load and author-export cancellation rules unchanged.
cancellation_exception_partial_commit.failure: Language missing-key fallback occurs before image resolution. A selected nonempty translated resource name goes to existing resource consumers; this proposal does not invent original-image retry when translated resource loading fails. Exact nil/empty/host failure semantics remain consumer-specific WP15 conditions.
cancellation_exception_partial_commit.partial_commit: Image construction can occur after viewport/sprite creation; no new transactional scene cleanup guarantee or runtime success claim.

negative_search.query: 本地化.{0,15}(图片|图像|资源)|翻译.{0,15}(图片|图像|资源)|语言.{0,15}(图片|图像|资源)|图.{0,8}本地化
negative_search.result: No explicit selected-language image substitution contract found. Directly read WP08, WP15 §3.1 and entire WP65 controls appendix; appendix localizes labels and names image files but does not state their image identity localization.

minimal_revision: Add an implementation-independent capability that selected-language material may select designated UI image variants, with missing translation retaining the original image identity. Point the controls key diagrams and representative battle/UI images to that rule; include one original-resource and one translated-resource input/output vector. Keep media existence and load failures in resource contracts, and avoid requiring source paths, Ruby APIs or an architecture.
preserved_scope: Not all image resources are translated; e.g. the controls backdrop is not wrapped by the translation service.
All 18 catalog domains retain their identities; resource strings are still SCRIPT_TEXTS entries.
No actual media presence, image rendering, reachable controls menu or language switch has been run.
No guarantee that a bad translated filename falls back to the original image.
No reference or framework implementation changes.
acceptance: For a missing translation, valid resource A is requested.
For a nonempty matching translation A→B, valid B is requested even when A exists.
Labels and fixed backdrop remain separate controls; only designated localized image identities vary.
Image-load failures and scene side effects keep existing qualified scope.
dependencies: WP08 selected-language lookup; WP15 resource loading; WP65 controls appendix; respective UI consumers.
Parent independent adjudication; proposal is not a final finding verdict.
